prompt: What does a JAR file contain?
choices: Compiled Java bytecode (.class files) and metadata, packaged in a ZIP-format archive
Only the main class, not dependencies
explanation: JAR (Java ARchive) bundles .class files, resources, and a META-INF/MANIFEST.MF. It's a ZIP archive. Fat/uber JARs also include all dependencies. Run with: java -jar myapp.jar
